	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_sanctuary_access_groups_favorable_count }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_custody_duties_favorable_count }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable >= 8 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable >= 5 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 8
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 3
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_total_favorable
	tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_sanctuary_access_groups_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_custody_duties_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

# -- tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_monthly_progress_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index ?= 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1662 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1663 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_sanctuary_access_groups_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1664 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1665 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index ?= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1666 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1667 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_custody_duties_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1668 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1669 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# -- tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_start_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_start_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_row_set_index value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_phase value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event
}
